co2_amine_modified_stokes.uncertainty: Amundsen2009 reports about 3% or 0.1 mPa s for typical loaded viscosity; propagated diffusivity uncertainty is not calculated

mea_free.uncertainty: source states fit within 5% over the complete temperature and concentration range; displayed Table III values are rounded

n2o_analogy.source_locator: Putta2017 PDF p. 14, Eq. 12; PDF pp. 14--15, Table 4
n2o_analogy.uncertainty: unknown because primary N2O rows and fit uncertainty were not recovered

weiland_density.equation: rho = sum(x_i M_i)/V; V = x1 V1 + x2 V2 + x3 V3 + x1 x2 A + x1 x3(B + C x1); V1 = M1/(D T_K^2 + E T_K + F)
weiland_density.source_locator: Amundsen2009 PDF p. 3 (printed p. 3098), Eqs. 4--6 and Table 10
weiland_density.input_basis: true species mole fractions and molecular masses; conversion is not admitted while issue33 basis is unresolved
weiland_density.uncertainty: about 0.2% for typical loaded systems, except highest temperatures/loadings

weiland_viscosity.equation: eta/eta_water = exp((((a w+b)T_K + (c w+d))(alpha(e w+f T_K+g)+1)w)/T_K^2)
weiland_viscosity.source_locator: Amundsen2009 PDF p. 4 (printed p. 3099), Eqs. 9--10 and Table 12
weiland_viscosity.input_basis: w is numerical MEA mass percent and alpha is mol CO2 per mol MEA
weiland_viscosity.uncertainty: about 3% or 0.1 mPa s for typical loaded MEA-water systems

candidate_A.closure: charged species share one source-defined effective diffusivity only if the source defines that lumping
missing_inputs: source-complete effective diffusivity for each of the nine species or a source-defined ion lump
accepted concentration basis and local state

candidate_B.flux_equation: J = -c M(x,D) [Gamma(x) d(ln x)/dz + z F/(R T) dpsi/dz]; N_i = J_i + x_i N_total

no_admission_rules: Do not compare candidate fluxes without an identical accepted state, admitted kinetics, and source-complete transport inputs.
Do not convert source mass density to a film molar density while issue33 concentration basis remains unresolved.
Do not construct a Maxwell-Stefan matrix or infer off-diagonal mobilities from one scalar ion value.
Do not tune a correlation to Case 3C, NCCC capture, or a physical film result.
